title: introduce-dependency-annotator-and-split-fast-feedback-ci-paths
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: feedback loops have been growing from ~8m to ~20m on PRs touching unrelated areas due to a monolithic CI graph and noisy dependency churn. This PR splits fast feedback lanes (lint/unit/smoke) from long-running checks, and adds a lightweight Dependency Annotator action that automatically detects dependency bumps in package manifests and annotates PRs with recommended labels and upgrade notes. Goals: 1) reduce time-to-first-green for reviewer-facing checks, 2) provide clear, machine-readable signals about dependency churn to reduce triage overhead, 3) centralize a small set of deterministic heuristics used by the release automation to decide staged rollouts. Summary of changes: - CI: introduce .github/workflows/ci-fast-path.yml and rewire existing build/test composite to only run when files outside 'infra/**' and 'third_party/**' are changed; long-running integration and cross-runtime matrix is gated to a new ci-integration.yml that runs on push to branches and nightly. - Dependency Annotator: new action .github/actions/dep-annotator/ that parses package.json, pyproject.toml, go.mod and Cargo.toml diffs and emits PR labels such as "dep:minor", "dep:major", "dep:doc-only" and an annotation block with the changed entries and suggested upgrade notes. - Release automation: small changes to release-helper to respect dep-annotator labels when deciding whether a change is eligible for automatic staging or requires manual review. - Repo hygiene: trimmed legacy shell helpers, replaced a few ad-hoc scripts with the shared ts-tooling entrypoint, and added unit tests for the annotator. Checklist: - [x] Add fast-path workflow and docs - [x] Implement dep annotator action + tests - [x] Wire annotator output to release-helper gating - [x] Update contributing docs (CONTRIBUTING.md) - [x] Add e2e smoke nightly job - [x] Manual QA on staging runner Notes on heuristics: the annotator uses a shallow parse and heuristic ranking: patch < minor < major. If only devDependencies or docs files are changed it emits "dep:doc-only" which suppresses auto-release. It does not attempt to resolve transitive upgrades or actually run package installers. Longform rationale: splitting the CI graph provides two measurable wins: reduced average latency for reviewer loops (lint + unit tests) by ~65% in internal experiments and reduced runner consumption for trivial PRs. Annotator helps triage: we observed ~30% of dependency PRs are bump/noise that should not trigger full integration runs or staged rollouts; labels allow release automation to treat them differently.
commits: feat(ci): add fast-path workflow and integration gate
feat(actions): dep annotator action with parsers and tests
refactor(scripts): replace legacy shell helpers with ts-tooling entrypoint
fix(ci): wire release-helper to read dep labels
small_diff_snippet:
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci-fast-path.yml
@@
- name: run all checks
- uses: ./ci/composite@v1
+ name: fast feedback
+ uses: ./ci/composite@v1
+ with: { scope: 'fast' }
review_thread: Arjun: The heuristics look reasonable; can we add an allowlist for deps that should always require integration testing? Maya: Added allowlist support and unit tests; moved config to .github/dep-policy.yaml so operations can update without code changes. Sofia: LH test flake on macOS runner — looks like a timing issue in the annotator tests; Evan suggested a small delay and deterministic temp dir; tests were updated. Approvals: Arjun approved 2026-02-18, Sofia approved after test fix 2026-02-19, Evan gave final sign-off 2026-02-19.
incidents_or_hotfix: During integration runs a flaky cross-runtime test failed once (SIGSEGV in runtime-mock) — unrelated to this PR. CI rerun succeeded and we added an integration-only retry policy to reduce noise.
release_notes: Introduce a lightweight Dependency Annotator that labels dependency bumps and a split CI fast-path to reduce reviewer feedback latency. No user-facing behavior change; internal build infrastructure and release automation updated.
post_merge_tasks:
- Monitor ci-fast-path queue for 24h to validate latency improvements
- Add opt-in for teams to configure dep-policy.yaml
- Roll out annotator to forks via docs and examples
notes_for_oncall: If you see a sudden increase in 'dep:major' labeled PRs, check dep-annotator logs at actions/dep-annotator and verify parsing for new manifest formats. Annotator logs to actions artifact 'dep-annotator-trace' on failure.
footprint_estimate: This change reduces median reviewer-latency by ~5-8 minutes for small PRs and removes ~20% of unnecessary integration job runs in our internal trial.
security_considerations: The annotator runs in a read-only mode against diffs and never executes package install commands. We added a lint rule to avoid executing code from PRs in CI actions. If future enhancements require deeper inspection, a request for privileged runners and SEC review will be required.
